scope: Mathematical extension specified while finite-seed reconstruction ran, before reviewing extracted results. Uses all chains and every archived scale; no target comparison.
selection: Every chain, both inherited-only and inherited-plus-fresh linear residuals, all eight scales.
identity: For group sizes M dividing N, a uniform fine group lies in a uniform coarse group and Cov(U_M,V_N)=Cov(U_N,V_N). The coarser regression residual is orthogonal to its predictors, so Cov(e_M,e_N)=Var(e_N).
derivation: Write lifted e_M=y_M-b_M x_M and e_N=y_N-b_N x_N. Coarse averaging yields y_N-b_M x_N=e_N+(b_N-b_M)x_N, whose covariance with e_N is Var(e_N). The same proof holds for a vector of inherited/fresh predictors.
outputs: 8x8 same-location nested covariance matrices and seven successive variance differences plus the coarsest residual variance.
boundaries: Scale increments are orthogonal nested-regression projection components, not necessarily geometric Haar wavelets.
No covariance of separated positions, angular multipoles, Fourier wavenumbers, geometric volume, primordial curvature, or CMB spectrum is identified.
Require monotone residual variances within numeric tolerance; reject violations without clipping.
